sections.title: Create and list reports handlers
sections.what: POST files a report about a member and returns it with status 201. GET returns the crew's list of reports.
sections.why: Likely reason: members report problems and the owner reviews them in one place.
sections.watch_out: The report body is checked by its shape only, so the service must check that the reported member is in the crew.

summary: Lets a signed-in member file a report about another member, and lets the crew see its list of reports.
purpose: Gives crews a way to raise problems with members and to review them.
why: Reason not stated in the code beyond the report and list pairing.
how: 1) POST confirms sign-in, reads the crew id, checks the report body, and files the report. 2) GET confirms sign-in, reads the crew id, and returns the reports list.
inputs: A POST with a report body and a crew id in the address. A GET with a crew id. The caller comes from the session.
outputs: POST returns the new report with status 201. GET returns a JSON list of reports.
risks: The list is returned only if the service allows the caller to see it, so that check must stay in the service.
debug: If reports do not appear, check the list function and the caller rights in the moderation service.
